title: Northbeam Credit Products: Cycle Days, Due Days and Minimum Payment Figures
content:
Four figures govern the billing period of an account in the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts range: the days in a statement period, the days after the statement closes that the payment falls due, the least payment as a percentage of the statement balance, and the least payment in money whatever that percentage gives.

| Product | Days in a statement period | Days after the statement closes that the payment falls due | Least payment as a percentage of the statement balance | Least payment in money |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbeam Store Card | 30 | 25 | 3.0 per cent | 29.00 |
| Northbeam Store Card Plus | 30 | 25 | 3.0 per cent | 29.00 |
| Northbeam Signature Rewards Card | 30 | 25 | 2.0 per cent | 35.00 |
| Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account | 30 | 25 | 4.0 per cent | 29.00 |
| Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account | 30 | 30 | 100.0 per cent | 0.00 |
| Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit | 30 | 45 | 5.0 per cent | 250.00 |

Money figures are US dollars.

## Notes on the figures

1. The statement period is 30 days on every product in the range, so the cycle length does not distinguish them.
2. The days to the due day are counted after the statement closes. A statement that closed on the third day of a month, on a product whose due days number 25, falls due on the twenty-eighth day of that same month. The due days differ across the range: 25 on the four consumer products, 30 on the Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account and 45 on the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit.
3. Where the percentage is 100.0, as on the Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account, the percentage asks for the whole statement balance. Where the money figure is 0.00, as on the same product, there is no money floor beneath the percentage.
4. The largest money figure in the range is the 250.00 of the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit and the smallest above nothing is the 29.00 carried by three products.
